text:
mira: Heads-up — onboarding magnet-14b-int4 to staging. Quick smoke showed state stitching errors once request chains cross ~65k tokens, repro attached below.

mira: repro (super minimal):
```
$ ./infer --model magnet-14b-int4 --prompt-file longchain.txt --stream=false
...
ERROR: cache_pointer_mismatch at layer 10 pos 65536 expected=65536 seen=0
```

sam: can you paste the exact prompt or a tiny split that reproduces? also which build/quant flags?

mira: using int4_legacy quant, quant_rounding=nearest, pos_scale=1.0, no special padding. longchain.txt is 70k tokens made by repeating a 1k-paragraph. i can upload a trimmed example.

jonathan: from the log it smells like a positional wrap — the rotary-phase indexing seems to wrap at 65536 boundary and the KV pointer isn't being remapped. we saw similar in fp16 a while back but this smells exacerbated by int4 packing.

elie: FWIW i hit divergence in a different run when context >32k: int4 memcpy into KV slab would sometimes zero-pad the tail when alignment != 128 bytes. that could produce the pointer mismatch symptom.

mira: tried toggling pos_scale to 0.5 and the error moves to pos 131072 (so it's scaling-related). toggling `kv_align_bytes=256` made the repro flaky but sometimes passes.

jonathan: hypothesis: two interacting bugs — (1) RoPE index wrap not mapped into compacted KV index space after window grow; (2) int4 write alignment causing tail zeros that look like "seen=0". both together create off-by-block pointer mismatch on replay.

sam: ok. mitigation plan? short-term fallback to magnet-14b-fp16 or disable int4_legacy on staging until we root cause. also add a long-context CI that does 10k/32k/65k sequences. i'll open a PR for the CI.

mira: filing INF-1428 with the repro and a trimmed prompt, linking to the staging logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/1719997777-longctx. also enabling "sticky-kv-rotate-fix" feature flag in staging to see if it masks the problem.

eval-bot: long-context-suite (magnet-14b-int4) completed: 4 failed / 12 total. failing tests: wrap_stitch_65k, align_zero_tail, cross_shard_replay, pos_scale_regression. Details: https://ci.redwood/tests/1719997777-longctx-report

elie: good catch on adding align checks. i'll add a unit test that writes random-length ints to the KV slab and verifies non-zero tail invariants.

jonathan: i'll bisect the rotary remap change from last month — maybe the fallback table omitted the large-index branch.

sam: PR for longctx-ci created: #5129. adding a smoke that runs two small repeating paragraphs to hit 65k quickly.

mira: thanks — if sticky-kv-rotate-fix stabilizes staging i'll try a canary release to Dedicated tomorrow. for now, keeping magnet-14b-int4 off prod.

sam: ack. please ping here when INF-1428 has repro steps and a smoke script so platform can block rollout automatically. :thumbsup:

mira: will do. attaching small trimmed prompt to the ticket so engineers can reproduce locally. :white_check_mark:
